items.rationale: The panel was about 2.4×0.85 m plus 2.4×0.4 m on the plinth, roughly 3.0 m², all inside the damage area. Laying at the upper customary rate is about 75 €/m².
One hole was actually needed through a new tile for the pipe, so it is necessary repair work. Price taken from the prior of about 70 € per hole.
Replacement tiles of the same size are owed for the 3 m² damage area, valued at cheapest-range standard tiles under 3.5(a).
Rebuilding the roughly 1 m² patch of render that went soft down to the brick is necessary, and the quantity matches the damage.
These duplicate the tile material already charged in line 3 and are an oversize, non-standard format. Excluded under 3.5(a), (d) and (e).
The internal corner runs 2.4 m and the end of the panel about 1.25 m, so 3.6 m is consistent with the work described.
This duplicates the silicone in line 6, the 12 m quantity is inconsistent with the damage, and the premium grade is an upgrade. Excluded under 3.5(a), (d) and (e).
Travel is paid once per contractor per document under 7.4.2. Prior value of about 80 €.
The unit-price lines already include labour (7.4.1), and 14 hours is excessive for a 3 m² panel (3.5(e)). At most a reduced amount for tile removal would be accepted.
Under 3.5(c), cleaning the reinstated surfaces within the damage area remains part of the repair cost. This is a small flat rate.
The boxing board was wet along the bottom, so removing it falls under opening up and debris removal (5.2.6 and 5.2.1).

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: The wet mineral wool from the boxing was taken away separately in the tiler's van, not via the container, so it is not a duplicate disposal. Prior value of about 74 €.
The damp render was hacked off over the same roughly 3 m² as the panel, which is necessary work in the damage area.
The attic gable staining dates from the re-felting years ago and has no link to the cellar leak. Unrelated and pre-existing, excluded under 3.5(b).
The cover ring cracked when the tiles came off, so it is part of making good. Valued at standard-grade price.
This covers undoing and remaking the joint, or setting up the dryer. Either is necessary work linked to the leak.
Seven days matches the documented readings, from well above normal to normal a week later (5.2.7). The owner's own dehumidifier is not billed.
Under 7.4.4 a flat surcharge is paid only if it can be attributed to required material such as the olive and sealing paste; otherwise it is overhead.
About 1 m of sodden lagging was replaced like for like. Prior value of about 22 €/m.
The container took the tiles, render and board and is the single debris removal charge under 5.2.1. Prior value of about 60 €.
